flows.name: A developer builds an AI agent with Mastra
flows.summary: As its getting-started page describes it: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for building AI agents and applications. The page also carries instructions addressed to coding agents; those are its content, not part of this map.

steps.what: Creates a Mastra project and installs its core package.
Defines an agent with its model, named as provider/model.
Gives the agent tools, each defined with createTool: an id, a description, an input schema and an execute function.
Runs, choosing tools to call; each call is validated against the tool's input schema and executed with a context the runtime provides (tracing, cancellation and request data).
steps.agent: Decides which tools to call to do its task.
